description: Standard CSV with Ticker,Weight header
requirement: CSV parser must skip header row and parse standard comma-separated Ticker,Weight rows.

description: Lowercase tickers with percentage symbols
requirement: CSV parser must uppercase lowercase ticker symbols and strip % signs.

description: Single-letter NYSE tickers (V, F, T)
requirement: CSV parser must support 1-to-5 letter US ticker symbols (including 1-letter tickers like V, F, T).

description: Tab-separated (TSV) input with header
requirement: CSV parser must handle tab-separated TSV rows and ignore header labels.

description: Duplicate ticker rows aggregated by summing weights
requirement: CSV parser must aggregate duplicate tickers by summing their weights rather than emitting duplicate ticker entries.

description: Zero and negative weights filtered out
requirement: CSV parser must reject zero or negative weights.

description: Summary and non-equity footer words ignored (TOTAL, CASH, SUM)
input:
TICKER,WEIGHT
XOM,70
NEE,30
TOTAL,100
SUM,100
CASH,0
requirement: CSV parser must filter reserved table words (TICKER, WEIGHT, SYMBOL, TOTAL, SUM, CASH, PORTFOLIO).

description: Semicolon-delimited decimal weights
requirement: CSV parser must support semicolon-delimited rows.

description: Double-quoted CSV cells with percent sign
requirement: CSV parser must strip surrounding quotes from ticker and weight fields.

description: Multi-column brokerage export with dollar value column after weight
requirement: CSV parser must extract the percentage weight per line and ignore trailing dollar columns.

description: Unnormalized weights [30, 30] normalize to [50.0, 50.0]
requirement: buildPortfolioProfiles must normalize input weights to sum to 100.0%.

description: Holdings sorted by most negative unpricedRiskPct ascending
requirement: buildPortfolioProfiles must sort holdings from highest unpriced risk (most negative %) to lowest.

description: Spec Hedge Limit: max 5.0 pts weight change per stock on AI & Cloud Leaders preset
requirement: Spec Layer 04: Per-stock weight delta |hedgedWeight - weight| must be <= 5.0 percentage points and one-way turnover <= 15.0%.

description: Exact hand-worked 2-stock hedge cap: NEE (80%) and MSFT (20%) capped at +/- 5.0 pts -> 75.0% and 25.0%
requirement: Spec Layer 04: For 2 stocks with severe vs low risk (NEE 80%, MSFT 20%), the +/- 5.0 pt cap binds directly to produce 75.0% and 25.0%.

description: Exact hand-worked 10-stock turnover cap: 5 high-risk & 5 low-risk stocks at 10% each must scale deltas from +/-5.0 to +/-3.0 so one-way turnover = 15.0%
requirement: Spec Layer 04: One-way turnover 0.5 * sum(|hedgedWeight - weight|) must never exceed 15.0% even with 10 holdings.

description: Hedged weights sum to 100.0% on Coastal Grid & Data REITs preset
requirement: Hedged portfolio weights must sum to 100.0% (+/- 0.1%).

description: Hedged weights sum to 100.0% on Fault-Line Hardware & Fabs preset
requirement: Fault-Line Hardware & Fabs preset must obey both <= 5.0 pt stock cap and <= 15.0% turnover cap.

description: Single-stock portfolio [NVDA 100%] stays at 100.0% with 0% turnover
requirement: A single-stock portfolio must remain 100.0% invested with 0% turnover.

description: Two stocks with identical unpriced risk keep unchanged weights (0% turnover)
requirement: Uniform risk portfolio must preserve 100% weight sum.

description: Directional sanity: highest-risk stock (NEE) weight decreases and lowest-risk stock (MSFT) weight increases
requirement: Risk hedging must shift weight out of the worst unpriced-risk stock and into the most resilient stock.

description: Hedged portfolio strictly improves net unpriced risk and Sharpe Ratio on AI & Cloud Leaders
requirement: Risk-hedged weights must improve net Unpriced Risk, Sharpe Ratio, and Max Drawdown.

description: Hand-worked turnover & transaction cost check on [NEE 80, MSFT 20] -> 5.0% turnover, 0.01% tx cost
requirement: computePortfolioMetrics must compute exact one-way turnover (5.0%) and transaction cost (0.01%).

description: Portfolio Exposure Score (/100) decreases when hedged on Coastal Grid & Data REITs
requirement: Risk-hedged portfolio must have a lower Exposure Score (/100) than Current Weights.

description: Unknown custom ticker fallback respects +/- 5.0 pt cap and sums to 100%
requirement: Custom/unknown tickers must be handled deterministically while obeying the +/- 5.0 pt hedge cap.

description: Small initial weight (NEE 2%, EQIX 48%, MSFT 50%) never becomes negative after hedging
requirement: No stock's hedged weight may ever be negative (w_hedged >= 0).
